title: descurainia depressa
intro: Descurainia depressa, commonly known as Western wallflower or more specifically, tansy mustard, is a plant species belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Descurainia depressa include isothiocyanates, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anticancer, and antiparasitic effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its potential to alleviate digestive issues and act as an antiseptic agent.
